batchRequest.request: Record that twelve tomato seed packets were used and add a supplier column to the inventory.

patchOf:
root = Stack([title, kpis, lowCallout, tbl, formHeader, form])
title = TextContent("Community Garden Seed Inventory", "large-heavy")
kpis = SnippetCardBlock([k1, k2, k3])
k1 = SnippetCardItem("total", k1l, k1r)
k1l = IconText(k1i, "neutral", "m", "Seed Varieties", "In inventory", false, "horizontal")
k1i = Icon("sprout", "nature")
k1r = BoldText("number", "8")
k2 = SnippetCardItem("packets", k2l, k2r)
k2l = IconText(k2i, "neutral", "m", "Total Packets", "All crops", false, "horizontal")
k2i = Icon("package", "shopping")
k2r = BoldText("number", "283")
k3 = SnippetCardItem("low", k3l, k3r)
k3l = IconText(k3i, "warning", "m", "Low Stock", "Under 20 packets", false, "horizontal")
k3i = Icon("triangle-alert", "alerts")
k3r = BoldText("number", "3")
lowCallout = Callout("warning", "Restock needed", "Beans, Carrots and Sunflowers are running low.")
tbl = Table([Col("Crop", crops), Col("Variety", varieties), Col("Quantity", qty, "number"), Col("Sowing Month", months), Col("Status", statuses)])
crops = ["Tomato", "Carrot", "Lettuce", "Pea", "Bean", "Pumpkin", "Sunflower", "Radish"]
varieties = ["Roma", "Nantes", "Butterhead", "Sugar Snap", "Kentucky Wonder", "Sugar Pie", "Mammoth", "Cherry Belle"]
qty = [45, 12, 60, 38, 15, 30, 8, 75]
months = ["March", "April", "March", "February", "May", "May", "April", "April"]
statuses = [Tag("In stock", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Low", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("In stock", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("In stock", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Low", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("In stock", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Low", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("In stock", null, "sm", "success")]
formHeader = InlineHeader("Restock Request", "Order more seeds for the garden")
form = Form("restock", btns, [fCrop, fQty, fMonth, fNotes])
fCrop = FormControl("Crop", Select("crop", cropOpts, "Select crop...", { required: true }))
cropOpts = [SelectItem("tomato", "Tomato - Roma"), SelectItem("carrot", "Carrot - Nantes"), SelectItem("lettuce", "Lettuce - Butterhead"), SelectItem("pea", "Pea - Sugar Snap"), SelectItem("bean", "Bean - Kentucky Wonder"), SelectItem("pumpkin", "Pumpkin - Sugar Pie"), SelectItem("sunflower", "Sunflower - Mammoth"), SelectItem("radish", "Radish - Cherry Belle")]
fQty = FormControl("Quantity (packets)", Input("quantity", "e.g. 25", "number", { required: true, min: 1 }))
fMonth = FormControl("Planned Sowing Month", Select("month", monthOpts, "Select month...", { required: true }))
monthOpts = [SelectItem("feb", "February"), SelectItem("mar", "March"), SelectItem("apr", "April"), SelectItem("may", "May")]
fNotes = FormControl("Notes", TextArea("notes", "Supplier or special requests...", 3))
btns = Buttons([Button("Submit Request", @ToAssistant("Submit restock request"), "primary"), Button("Clear", @ToAssistant("Clear restock form"), "secondary")])
request: Record that twelve tomato seed packets were used and add a supplier column to the inventory.
